lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: This story addressed the review round 2 WARNING: three doc comments in behavioral-gate.ts and the test file header/describe title had gone stale relative to the CAM-466 US-001/US-002/US-003 behavior they describe. Fixes (comments only, no behavior change): (1) NoRunnableOracle's doc comment no longer names the sibling MalformedOracle kind or asserts the inverted mapping -- it now says 'empty payload or a bare kind label with nothing after it' and cross-references MalformedOracle for the boundary. (2) parseOracleDirectives' doc comment now names both outcomes correctly: empty/unrecognized-label text yields no-oracle, an unterminated mark yields malformed (previously claimed all malformed text yields no-oracle, which is false post-US-003). (3) parseOracleDirective's doc comment replaced both 'suffix' occurrences with 'mark', since US-001's un-anchoring means the oracle directive is no longer required to be a suffix. (4) test file header updated from the stale 6-item US-001-only coverage list to an 8-item list covering the CAM-466 additions (label stripping, un-anchored extraction, malformed kind), and the describe title 'parseOracleDirective: no-oracle (malformed)' (colliding with the real malformed kind added by a later story) renamed to 'parseOracleDirective: no-oracle (empty or bare label)'. Full check:all spine green (5768 tests pass, lint/file-size/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok). No remaining findings from review round 2 known to this story; round 1's 4 non-blocking SUGGESTIONs (behavioral-gate.ts doc wording, an untested edge case, agent-doc contracts not enumerating 'malformed') may still be tracked in prd.json's review.findings for the reviewer/orchestrator to triage -- this story only closed the round 2 WARNING, not those older SUGGESTIONs.
